title: Very Pretty Starfish
text: Very Pretty Starfish. Lovely colors and great for crafting!

product_metadata.title: Starfish Decor - 10 Pack Green & Blue Assorted Star Fish 4-6 Inch - Starfish for Crafts - Blue Green Starfish Wall Décor - Beach Wedding Starfish - Beach Starfish Décor - Star Fish Decorations
features: YOU WILL RECEIVE – a mixed assortment of real large Starfish for a total of (10) Blue & Green Finger Starfish that range in size from 4 to 6 inches, plus a complimentary PDF copy of "A Practical Guide for Nautical Décor" eBook by Joseph Rains (delivered by E-mail).

STARFISH FOR CRAFTS - Design and create inspiring Starfish ornaments for Christmas, wedding favors, jewelry, candles, frames, mirrors, white starfish craft decorations make great gifts for all occasions.  Perfect for hobbies and crafts of all types whether dressing up an aquarium or decorating for a mermaid or under the sea themed party, starfish themed décor is sure to delight your family friends and guests alike.

BEACH DECOR FOR THE HOME – Natural Starfish shells are great for tables, mirrors, lamps, vase filler, candle votives, wall art, wreaths, beach wedding decorations and ocean party starfish decorations.  Pair Starfish with other sea life such as Sand Dollars, small starfish and Urchins to add a decorative beachy vibe or coastal decorations for home.
SEA SHELLS FOR DECORATING - Star fish shells, fish nets along with large sea shells make great nautical decorations and are perfect for beach table décor
PROFESSIONALLY PACKAGED - Handpicked and carefully packaged, our sea star shells will arrive in prime condition and add beauty to your coastal décor for years to come.
